summary: 32-year-old climber fell from the Knife Edge on Capitol Peak; three Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers were later injured by rockfall during the body recovery.
location: Knife Edge, Capitol Peak (Northeast Ridge), Elk Range
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff; Mountain Rescue Aspen; Army National Guard HAATS helicopter; CareFlight of the Rockies
notes: Climber Kelly McDermott reported missing 2021-08-01; body found 2021-08-04 ~500 ft below Knife Edge; on 2021-08-04 a rockslide struck four MRA recovery volunteers, three injured (one seriously, airlifted); victim count includes the 3 injured rescuers. SnowBrains/PCSO: McDermott, 32, of Madison WI, last seen Sat 2021-07-31 at 8 p.m. at the Capitol Peak trailhead parking lot; body spotted from a helicopter Wednesday 2021-08-04 ~500 ft below the Knife Edge, cause of death unclear; three MRA volunteers struck by massive rockfall likely triggered by recreational climbers above on the Knife Edge during the recovery - one seriously injured (flown to a Denver-area hospital for emergency surgery), recovery aborted. 2026-09-20: merged GCSAR FB post permalink (GCSAR well-wish post referencing the 2021-08-01 Capitol Peak incident (deceased climber re).
